name: Spectral Adaptive Sampling
aliases: Adaptive GPU Ray Casting Based on Spectral Analysis
definition: An adaptive ray casting algorithm that uses the spectral decomposition of the composite signal (transfer function composed with dataset) to derive a sampling criterion, reducing sample points by 50-80% compared to non-adaptive methods without quality loss.
summary: Spectral Adaptive Sampling is a volume rendering acceleration technique that determines sampling step size based on the spectral decomposition of the composite signal, preventing aliasing from non-linear opacity mappings.
